metadata.question: Does the GERD reservoir (Ethiopia) water level decrease in February 2022 compared to September 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 SAR (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD) over a polygon covering the GERD reservoir area. Compare two monthly windows: 2021-09-01..2021-10-01 and 2022-02-01..2022-03-01. If no images, expand windows as fallback.
2. Masking strategy: SAR is cloud-penetrating; no cloud masking needed. Convert VV to dB and classify water with a fixed threshold (VV_dB < -17 dB).
3. Logic: Check collection sizes (C1), valid pixel counts after processing (C2), and null/NaN results (C3). Decide A/B by comparing water surface area (km²) with a small tolerance.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[34.95, 10.85],
     [35.80, 10.85],
     [35.80, 11.75],
     [34.95, 11.75],
     [34.95, 10.85]]
  ]);
  const sepStart = '2021-09-01';
  const sepEnd = '2021-10-01';
  const febStart = '2022-02-01';
  const febEnd = '2022-03-01';
  const scaleMeters = 1000; // per instruction: use ≥1000m to avoid timeouts
  const waterThresholdDB = -17; // VV dB threshold for water
  const deltaTolKm2 = 1.0; // tolerance to avoid noise-driven decisions

  function getS1Col(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'));
  }

  async function getCompositeWithFallback(start, end) {
    let col = getS1Col(start, end);
    let n = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (n === 0) {
      const start2 = ee.Date(start).advance(-15, 'day');
      const end2 = ee.Date(end).advance(15, 'day');
      col = getS1Col(start2, end2);
      n = await col.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (n === 0) {
      const start3 = ee.Date(start).advance(-30, 'day');
      const end3 = ee.Date(end).advance(30, 'day');
      col = getS1Col(start3, end3);
      n = await col.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (n === 0) {
      return {count: 0, imgDB: null};
    }
    // Median composite in linear units, then mask and convert to dB
    const vvLin = ee.Image(col.median()).select('VV');
    const vvMasked = vvLin.updateMask(vvLin.gt(0));
    const vvDB = ee.Image(10).multiply(vvMasked.log10()).rename('VV_dB');
    return {count: n, imgDB: vvDB};
  }

  async function summarize(imgDB, label, imgCount) {
    const validCount = await imgDB.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scaleMeters,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('VV_dB').getInfo();
    if (validCount === null || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} Images: ${imgCount}, ValidPx: 0`);
      return {ok: false, validPx: 0, waterKm2: null};
    }
    const waterMask = imgDB.lt(waterThresholdDB);
    const waterArea = await waterMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scaleMeters,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('VV_dB').getInfo();
    const waterKm2 = waterArea ? (waterArea / 1e6) : null;
    if (waterKm2 === null || isNaN(waterKm2)) {
      console.log(`${label} Images: ${imgCount}, ValidPx: ${validCount}, Water_km2: null`);
      return {ok: false, validPx: validCount, waterKm2: null};
    }
    console.log(`${label} Images: ${imgCount}, ValidPx: ${validCount}, Water_km2: ${waterKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    return {ok: true, validPx: validCount, waterKm2: waterKm2};
  }

  try {
    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const sep = await getCompositeWithFallback(sepStart, sepEnd);
    const feb = await getCompositeWithFallback(febStart, febEnd);

    if (sep.count === 0 || feb.count === 0) {
      console.log(`Sep2021 Images: ${sep.count}`);
      console.log(`Feb2022 Images: ${feb.count}`);
      console.log("C1");
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Area Calculation
    console.log(`Water threshold (VV dB): ${waterThresholdDB}`);
    const sepStats = await summarize(sep.imgDB, 'Sep2021', sep.count);
    const febStats = await summarize(feb.imgDB, 'Feb2022', feb.count);

    // 4. Validation
    if (!sepStats.ok || !febStats.ok) {
      if ((sepStats.validPx === 0) || (febStats.validPx === 0)) {
        console.log("C2");
        return;
      }
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // 5. Decision
    const delta = febStats.waterKm2 - sepStats.waterKm2;
    console.log(`Change_km2 (Feb - Sep): ${delta.toFixed(1)}`);
    if (delta < -deltaTolKm2) {
      console.log("A");
    } else {
      console.log("B");
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Catch syntax/memory/API errors
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
